places.name: Amazon Basin
places.label: Tropical
places.detail: Hot through the year. Much rain falls in the rainforest.

places.name: Mediterranean
places.label: Temperate
places.detail: This is one type of temperate climate. Summers are dry. Winters are mild and wet.

places.name: Arctic
places.label: Polar
places.detail: Very cold for much of the year. The warm season is short.

places.name: Japan
places.label: Earthquake
places.detail: Japan is near plate edges. Earthquakes can happen here.

places.name: Indonesia
places.label: Volcano
places.detail: Indonesia is near plate edges. It has many volcanoes.

places.name: Sahara
places.label: Dry
places.detail: Very little rain falls here. Dry is a climate type too.

places.name: Iceland
places.label: Earthquake and volcano
places.detail: Iceland is on a plate edge. It can have both hazards.

precision: Points and outlines approximate; broad belts are a teaching guide, not detailed climate boundaries.
